scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n build,electron -c cyan,magenta "node esbuild.config.mjs --watch" "wait-on dist/main.cjs dist/preload.cjs && electron ."
scripts.package: node scripts/build-resources.mjs && node esbuild.config.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.release: node scripts/build-resources.mjs && node esbuild.config.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish always
